subject: Integration playlist + workshop: dashboards, tracing hooks, alert routing
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Kumari <aisha@skyline.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integration playlist + workshop: dashboards, tracing hooks, alert routing

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the sync yesterday. Per our conversation, I put together a short \"integration playlist\" so we can structure the first two-week implementation sprint and the kickoff workshop. High level agenda we recommend for the 90-minute workshop:

- Quick scope review (10m): sources of telemetry, retention constraints, and priority services
- Dashboards (25m): key SLOs, token-level cost/latency charts, and rollout views
- Tracing hooks (20m): recommended span names, sampling strategy, and headers to propagate
- Error taxonomy & routing (20m): how we classify inference errors vs. app errors and suggested alert lanes
- Runbook & ownership (15m): on-call routing, escalation path, and playbook handoff

Attachments: integration-playlist-v1.xlsx (workshop checklist & sprint tasks), alert-routing-sketch.png (example routing lanes).

Ask: can you confirm whether Oct 6 or Oct 7 (10–11:30am PT) works for your team for the workshop? Also helpful if you can loop in whoever owns the Skyline infra alerts (we flagged infra@skyline.ai) so we can align runbook ownership.

Prep request (short):
- Share a link to any existing dashboards or alert groups you want mapped (Drive or Grafana).
- A one-line summary of your SLA targets for inference (p50/p95 latency, error budget).

If those dates don't work we'll stagger a two-part series.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0122

--
Redwood Inference — Make inference predictable and economical
From: Aisha Kumari <aisha@skyline.ai>

Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Integration playlist + workshop: dashboards, tracing hooks, alert routing

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the clear plan. Oct 6 (10–11:30am PT) works best for our SRE and product leads; I've added our infra alias and Tom Reyes (who manages alerting) to the thread.

A few quick notes from our side:
- We'll share our current Grafana folder and the SLA doc by Monday (I've asked Tom to attach the links).
- Our p95 latency target for generation calls is 600ms; p50 is ~120ms. Error budget is small so we'd like to prioritize a low-noise alerting lane.
- We use a mix of sampled tracing (1%) for end-to-end and 100% local spans for inference service internal traces; curious on Redwood's recommendations for header propagation and span naming.

Workshop format preference: interactive — please reserve 40 minutes for live mapping (dashboards + alert lanes) so we can leave with concrete ownership.

I'll accept the calendar invite once I see the event link.

Best,
Aisha Kumari
Head of Product Ops, Skyline AI
aisha@skyline.ai

Attached: integration-playlist-v1.xlsx (workshop timeline + owner table). Please review the sheet titled "Data & Access" — we list the Grafana dashboards and IAM permissions we'll need.

Quick practical notes for the team:
- We'll bring a template dashboard (token breakdown, p50/p95 latency, model variant churn) and an example tracing snippet showing header names we recommend (X-Request-ID, X-Model-Version).
- For alerts, we suggest separating: 1) Customer-impact (high priority), 2) Model-degradation (medium — tied to eval regressions), 3) Infra/backpressure (low-to-medium). We'll map these to your on-call rotations during the workshop.

Next steps for Redwood internal team: Monica to run through dashboard template; Ben to draft a proposed error taxonomy; Laura to coordinate runbook owners.

See you Wednesday.

Marcus

Team —

Putting a short internal checklist here so we don't scramble during the workshop: please treat as action items for Wednesday. I'll be on the call as PM.

- Monica: load the token-breakdown dashboard into a disposable org and confirm all panels render with synthetic data by Tuesday EOD (attachment: alert-routing-sketch.png).
- Ben: draft an error taxonomy doc (one-pager) mapping Redwood error classes -> Skyline alert lanes; include example thresholds for p50/p95 and error-rate spikes. Target: Tue 5pm PT.
- Marcus: lead the tracing hook section and prepare the sample span naming guide (include header list).
- Me (Laura): I'll create the runbook template and pre-populate escalation paths with Skyline's on-call alias once Tom confirms rotations.

If anything slips, call me. We'll do a 30-minute internal dry run Tuesday 3pm PT. Calendar invite sent.

Laura Bennett
